description: Show the user one of this server's models (created with create_model) as an interactive card in the chat. Every edit the user makes in the card is a mutate on the model, so get_state and explain see it. Use it after create_model or evolve_spec when the user should see or try the model. The model needs a viewDefinition. To show a spec without creating a model, use render_model instead.
name: show_model
title: Show a stored Valem model
